Two #hMPV Cases Detected in #Bengaluru During Routine ICMR Surveillance

A 3-month-old female infant and an 8-month-old male infant were admitted to Baptist Hospital with a history of bronchopneumonia.

The female infant has been discharged

nodes.text:
Two #hMPV Cases Detected in #Bengaluru During Routine ICMR Surveillance

A 3-month-old female infant and an 8-month-old male infant were admitted to Baptist Hospital with a history of bronchopneumonia.

The female infant has been discharged, while the male infant is recovering.
